title: Anthropic IPOs, Topping SpaceX for the Largest Ever
content_html:
Anthropic IPOs, Topping SpaceX for the Largest Ever

My skepticism remains twofold: (a) there is no permanent moat around LLM technology, only a temporary one at the frontier that’s fueled by an enormous bubble pumped up by Jensen Huang at Nvidia; (b) even if I’m wrong on the first part, this particular cult of religious freaks and weirdos isn’t fit to lead a public company.

★ Thursday, 19 November 2026
